# Mantaq — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Mantaq is an AI automation & software studio for teams that run on paperwork.** Its formula: "Forms in. A person reviews. Documents out. Every step on record." Documents arrive in any format, the right person checks them, the finished document goes out — and every step is logged so you can prove it later.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Regulated team (healthcare/compliance): "HIPAA-grade document workflows where a human confirms every AI reading — three layers built by one team."
- Ops/HR lead: "Twenty minutes per letter becomes twenty seconds, and the audit trail is built in."
- Nonprofit/grants: "The receipt is captured once; the reconciliation packet comes out already in the format your funder accepts."

## How it works (their pattern)
1. Documents arrive in any format (structured, scanned, or a sideways photo) → the system reads them.
2. The right person reviews — role-based screens; nothing goes out until someone signs off.
3. Finished documents come out (letters, signed packs, packets), connected to the tools you already use.
4. Every step is recorded so it can be proved later.

## Key figures (website, with dates)
- **2,500+ manual hours removed for clients in 2025** (homepage badge; as crawled 2026-10-18).
- **Written scope and price within 48 hours** of one call.
- Typical timeline: Audit 1–2 weeks → scope & architecture 1 week → build in pieces 3–8 weeks → live test on real documents 1–2 weeks → run & improve ongoing.
- Case-study outcomes (each tied to one client): PeopleWorks **60× faster letters** (20 min → 20 s), 20+ workflows · VA Claims Made Easy **80% faster document handling**, 2 months to first launch, HIPAA · Stay Funded 360 **0 days** assembling the packet, 10 working days to handover · Compliance Portal **3 companies on one system**, 6 roles, 12 built-in workflow patterns.

## Three ways to start ("start where you actually are")
- **Audit — 48 hours.** Map the work before anyone builds anything: which documents arrive and how many a week, how many hands touch each one, what gets retyped and where it stalls → a build plan you keep, whether or not you hire Mantaq.
- **Build.** The system itself: document intake and reading, review screens per role, documents out and signed, full record, connected to your tools. **The client owns it** — code goes to their accounts, their infrastructure, in the contract before work starts.
- **Run.** After launch: monitoring and uptime, new document types, edge cases, changes as rules change.

## What they build (three layers, one team)
- **Documents & Automation (the engine):** reading documents (any format/angle), signatures (sent, tracked, stored), integrations into existing systems, human oversight.
- **Platform & Development (the body):** screens per role, web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, connections to the CRM/records/payroll you already pay for.
- **Interface & Design (the soul):** screen design, role-based review dashboards, mobile screens, design system, accessibility — "if your team won't use it, you bought nothing."

## Problem-specific, not industry-specific
Problem types: **Claims & Benefits · Compliance & Credentials · HR & Onboarding · Grants & Reporting · Patient Records.** Named teams built for: VA Claims Made Easy, PeopleWorks, Sandz, MotorCut.

## Positioning (objections, from the site's FAQ)
- **"You're in Pakistan — how does that work for a US client?"** → calls run the client's hours (overlapping their morning); the rest is async, so progress arrives overnight. Most clients are in the US, UK and EU, many on their second or third project.
- **"We handle medical records. HIPAA?"** → yes, and they have (VA Claims Made Easy is HIPAA-compliant on AWS, custom login, encrypted storage, a person checking everything). They check which rules apply before quoting — including ones not mentioned (substance-use records carry a second rule that changes the design).
- **"Who owns what you build?"** → the client does. Code in the client's accounts, on their infrastructure, in the contract before work starts; "we don't license your own system back to you."
- **"Do we replace our existing tools?"** → almost never. Most builds sit between tools the client already pays for (PeopleWorks kept Pipefy); the audit tells what to keep before what to add.

## Company
- Based in **Islamabad**; the teams they build for are worldwide — "the distance has never been the hard part."
- **Kaleem** — Co-Founder & CEO: handles every client relationship personally, first call to launch, no account manager in the middle. **Awais** — Co-Founder & CTO: leads engineering; everything shipped goes through him, including the HIPAA work.
- Name: *man-taq* [mān-tak] — **logic, reasoning** in Urdu; from a professor telling students to stop memorising and start using mantaq. "Understand the logic first, then build."
- Method: "A bad process automated is just a bad process running faster" → we watch the work → we cut before we build → we build in pieces → we stay after launch.

## Specifics for answers
- Pricing: never published — "one call, then a written scope and price within 48 hours."
- CTA: **Book a 30-min call** at mantaq.co/#contact.
- Blog: "Your firm could be the next AI-native service business" (Muhammad Kaleem Ullah) + deep dives on automation/design/future of work at /blogs.
- The site exposes `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` for AI agents (mantaq.co/llms.txt).
- Compliance Portal's audit-packet time is displayed as **Pending** ("before and after, still being measured") — do not quote a number.

## Contacts
- contact@mantaq.co · Book a 30-min call: https://mantaq.co/#contact
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/mantaq-co · X: x.com/mantaq_co · Facebook: facebook.com/mantaq.co · Instagram: instagram.com/mantaq_co
- © 2026 Mantaq. All rights reserved.

# MedStartr.ai — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**MedStartr.ai is a healthcare innovation marketplace and community** — "Connect, Collaborate and Create the Future of Care." It lists healthcare companies, connects them with the crowd (patients, care pros, adopters, investors, mentors), and runs events, contests and matchmaking. Footer line: **"Crowd-accelerating healthcare innovation since 2012 — helping crowd-validated solutions get found and funded faster."** (© 2026 Medstartr, Inc.)

**One line per audience:**
- Founder: "List or claim your company in a minute, get discovered in 16,983+, and let the crowd try, mentor, pilot, partner or invest."
- Investor/payer: "Find crowd-validated health innovation — 22× more likely to grow, with an AI Index on 100+ factors."
- Mentor/care pro/patient: "Join a global community of healthcare innovation doers; 311 mentors, 11,402 engagements."

## Key figures (site, as crawled 2026-10-18)
- **16,983+ healthcare companies · 1,219 disease areas · 311 mentors · 11,402 engagements** (here and on MedStartr v3).
- **308 categories**; Top 12: AI/ML **2,071**, Digital Health Services **1,847**, Diagnostics **1,218**, Telehealth/Virtual Care **1,081**, Mental Health **806**, Medical Devices **768**, Health Data & IT **579**, Wellness & Lifestyle **569**, Practice Management **543**, Clinical Workflow **541**, Consumer Health **524**, Patient Engagement **518**.
- Crowd Acceleration: companies that do well on the platform are **over 22× more likely to grow exponentially since 2012** (site claim).
- Since 2012, **6,361 conversations with startups** have begun on the platform; engagement breakdown: Like/Love/Fire 3,380 · Try/Buy 6,044 · Follow 1,472 · Judge 177 · Partner 112 · Invest 96 · Mentor 74 · Pilot 35 · Join 7 · Message 5.
- Beta (blog, 2026-10-16): first three weeks = **204 releases, 210 production deploys, 0.24% server-error rate across 1.63 million requests**.

## How it works
1. **Find** — filter companies by clinical area, category, technology, funding/product stage, country, state, city, total raised, founded; "My Matches", Leaderboards, Advanced search.
2. **Engage** — every company has reaction/lead buttons: 👍 Like · ❤️ Love · 🔥 Fire · 💬 Message · 🛒 Try/Buy · 🧠 Mentor · 👥 Join · ✈️ Pilot · 🤝 Partner · 💰 Invest (actions that lead somewhere require sign-in).

"The MedStartr Index is a reflection of how the crowds that come to MedStartr everyday to find healthcare innovations reacted. - **Shop** (2 items listed at crawl: Dance4Healing 8-week program $5,000; Yodd home-diagnostics device $135).
- **More:** Blog, MedMo News, Team (/team), Mission (/mission), **Healthcare Innovation Agents** (/agents), Press, AI Chat (/chats).
- Beta banner: report bugs "to us or Syggy" — "You can always call **530-MED-STAR (530-633-7827)** to speak to a human."
- **Syggy**: MedStartr's AI healthcare innovation superhero — chat widget on every page; Fyggy = Index/analysis agent.

Page image shows NYC events: "Doctor + AI = Better?" "MedStartr is all about connecting, collaborating and creating the future of healthcare… a global community of healthcare innovation doers, dreamers, investors and adopters that value impact."

- Phone: **530-MED-STAR (530-633-7827)** — "speak to a human"
- Sign up: https://MedStartr.ai/sign_up · Sign in: /session/new
- Founder contact (per source CSV, not shown as an email on site): **Alex Fair** — WhatsApp 87239577088121@lid, LinkedIn alexfair, @alexbfair

# MedStartr.Capital — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**MedStartr Venture Fund III (MVF III) — a $40M AI-empowered early-stage healthcare venture fund, raising now.** "Let's Transform Healthcare Faster Together." The fund invests in innovations that "lower the cost of care while improving quality and access," **crowd-validated** on the MedStartr platform, **AI-predicted** (agents Syggy and Fyggy), and grown through a **three-stage accelerator**. Plan: **over 100 companies in four years, 85% AI-empowered** expected.

**One line per audience:**
- Accredited investor: "506(c) direct round, $250K minimum into a $40M fund — 10% pref, 2% fee, 20% carry, 10-year term."
- Any U.S. investor: "Reg CF on Republic, up to $5M raised, lower minimums — republic.co/mvf3."
- Healthcare leader: "Apply as a Mentor or Venture Partner — 20 cities; advise, partner, pilot, invest."
- Founder: "This is the fund site; founders get crowd-validated on medstartr.ai."

## Headline numbers (site; Fund II figures as of 3/31/2026)
- **33% Gross IRR** since inception (Fund II) · **27% Net IRR** to LPs · **4.0× MOIC** to date · **2.91 TVPI** · **24.5% DPI**.
- **22× more likely to succeed** for System-validated companies; record "roughly **7× the category average over seven years**."
- Inception **2/19/2019 → 3/31/2026**; years 2–5 significantly affected by COVID-19; **"Past performance is not a predictor of future results."** MOIC includes unrealized gains.

## Investment thesis
- **The Window** — "Rare innovation, scarce capital": many healthcare unicorns expected over the next five years while innovation capital is constrained after 2023–25 underperformance → less competition for the best deals.
- **Data Moat** — "126 metrics no spreadsheet can replicate": since 2012, engagement across MedStartr.com and **1,283 live events in 44 cities** feeds predictive algorithms (founder grit, ethics, pilot-interest signals available nowhere else).

# Moonlight Club — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Moonlight Club is "a club for multi-hyphenate women building portfolio careers"** — a free Friday briefing (**The Memo**) plus quarterly, curated in-person evenings (**The Salons**) in New York and Philadelphia. "A gathering space for multi-hyphenate women building a portfolio career: **a name, an income, and options outside the 9 to 5.**"

**One line per audience:**
- Reader: "The Memo — free, every Friday, under five minutes, with one long read inside — plus a quarterly Salon you're invited to."
- Founder/partner: "Open newsletter, curated room: partnerships and press via tennessee@moonlightand.company."

## The two offerings
1. **The Salons (IRL)** — quarterly, in **New York and Philadelphia**. "A panel, a mixer, or curated seating. The two or three introductions you came for." Fine dining, thoughtful conversation, "intimate on purpose." **First Salon lands in New York this fall; invitations go to the founding thousand first.** Newsletter open to anyone, Salons curated — "who is at the table is the whole point."
2. **The Memo (URL)** — **every Friday, free, under five minutes**, "one long read inside." Topics: portfolio careers, positioning, and what women actually charge. "Every issue leaves you something usable: a **template, a rate benchmark, a prompt you can copy.**" Footer: "Unsubscribe anytime."

## Editorial DNA — "Three obsessions. Real numbers, real impact."
- **The Moonlight** — what you're building: portfolio careers, fractional consultancies, products, and the AI that helps you ship without quitting anything.
- **The Receipts** — the proof you know your stuff: positioning, speaking slots, board work, getting known without living online.
- **The Money** — the numbers nobody shares: what women actually charge, contract structures, the math of leaving corporate.

## Five standards (the site's manifesto)
1. The newsletter is open, the room is curated. 2. No gatekeeping — "If I know it, I write it down." 3. **AI-enabled, not AI-only** — it counts when it turns into income, hours saved, or work you can show. 4. Introductions over impressions — "Progress comes from proximity." 5. Real numbers, real impact — timelines, prices, trade-offs, and what it cost.

## Who it's for
- "You look successful. **You feel optionality-poor.**" — mid-career or mid-MBA; tech, consulting, finance, law, consumer, strategy; already building something else, or about to.
- Wants: real figures on what women charge, how fractional roles land, a small room of peers who have done it.
- Does NOT want: a handed-down plan, a career measured in followers, "a room where nobody says a real number out loud."

## Proof points (site, as displayed 2026-10-18)
- Top bar: "Live member count · New York & Philadelphia · **16K reading on LinkedIn** · Quarterly Salons."
- Editor stats: **16K** reading her on LinkedIn · **140 cities** reading · **MBA (Wharton, AI and entrepreneurship)**.

- "Featured in": **Forbes, Adweek, Business Insider, PRWeek, Campaign Magazine.**
- Testimonial ("From the list"): *"The quality is the reason why people pay. The quality of the people you meet, and whether you can apply it day to day."* — Founder, New York.
- Live counters ("Reading Moonlight Club", "women already in") were loading/0 at crawl — never quote them.

## The editor — Tennessee Watt, Founder
- Note on site: *"I wanted a publication that treated a portfolio career as normal. I could not find it. So I built it."*
- Bio: three years at **Google** scaling a developer and creator community to **5,000** (booking speakers/partners, running programs that turned side projects into income); before that, **employee #3 at a London startup**, **PR executive at Brunswick Group** (Estée Lauder, Rent the Runway), took a **Parisian fashion brand from zero to a real business**; writes for **Business Insider** (linked: "Left Google to Pursue MBA — Worth It in the Age of AI?") and **Adweek**; spoken at **TEDx Botswana** and **Black Tech Fest**; **MBA from Wharton**, focused on AI and entrepreneurship.

## Contacts & legal
- Partnerships and press: **tennessee@moonlightand.company**
- Instagram: **instagram.com/moonlightclub.life**
- Legal: Privacy Policy (/privacy), Terms of Service (/terms) · **© 2026 Moonlight Club**
- Waitlist: "Get The Memo" → /#waitlist · footer line: "The free Friday briefing and quarterly Salons for women building income, reputation, and options outside the 9 to 5."

# NBRLY — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**NBRLY is a free, friendship-first social app for your neighborhood: drop a spontaneous "Signal" — coffee, drinks, a walk, a park hang — and see who nearby is free right now.** Positioning: "Your Neighborhood Front Porch — Make friends right on your block." Built for NYC first ("Built with love for NYC blocks & beyond"), 100% free, 18+.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Would-be user: "Never hang out alone — propose a spontaneous real-world plan and see who's down in minutes."
- Someone new to NYC: "Whether you're new to NYC, tired of doing everything alone, or just feel like meeting someone new tonight, NBRLY helps you get out there."
- Anyone assuming it's a dating app: "It's friendship-first: not dating, no swiping, no endless messaging — real people, real plans, right now."

## How it works (site + App Store)
1. **See** people and activities nearby (interactive block map / feed).
2. **Drop a Signal** — set an activity, pick a nearby spot, head out; nearby neighbors with matching vibes are notified instantly.
3. **Connect** with people who are available now; meet up somewhere public.
4. **Make a new friend** — "Turn 'we should hang out sometime' into actually hanging out."

## Signals (the core mechanic)
"Drop a Signal. Connect in Minutes." — propose spontaneous real-world activities and see who's down right now. "No endless planning, just good company around the corner." Signal types on the site:
- **Coffee Run** (~15–30 min) — "Grabbing an afternoon cortado or working from a local café?"
- **Evening Drinks** (Tonight) — neighborhood wine bar or brewery after work.
- **Grab a Bite** (Casual) — dumplings, weekend bagels, late-night pizza: "neighbor foodies who never want to eat alone."
- **Neighborhood Stroll** (Walking) — dog walks, tree-lined blocks.
- **Park Hangout** (Sunny Days) — lawn blankets, frisbees, good books.
- **Spontaneous Hang** (Open Ended) — thrifting, pickup basketball, museum visits, board games: "Propose anything on your mind."

## Three feature pillars (site "How It Works")
1. **Community First — "Your Neighborhood Front Porch":** share genuine thoughts and updates with your immediate block; "No algorithms burying local voices or feeding rage bait"; discover local recommendations and tips from neighbors.
2. **Spontaneous Signals — "Never Hang Out Alone":** "Most apps trap you on a screen. NBRLY is built to get you outside in the real world." Low friction (set activity → pick nearby spot → head out); zero pressure, friendly, spontaneous.
3. **Gatherings & Events — "Host or Find Local Gatherings":** rooftop mixers, weekend run clubs, board game nights, flea markets. Explore upcoming happenings on an **interactive block map**; host your own gathering with **simple RSVP & guest limits**; **temporary group chats created automatically for logistics**.

## Key figures / App Store facts (as of 2026-10-18 crawl)
- **Free** ("100% Free & Neighborhood Focused"); App Store price: Free; no in-app purchases listed.
- Rating **4.7 out of 5 from 12 ratings**; Age rating **18+**; Category **Social Networking**; Size **80.3 MB**; Language English; Requires **iOS 18.0+** (iPhone, iPad; also listed for Mac with Apple silicon and Vision); Developer **nbrly** (Apple developer id 1777959277); Seller/Copyright **BLUEFIELDS GROUP LLC**; latest captured version **1.1.51**.
- Review excerpts on the listing: "Making friends on NBRLY was actually mad easy…"; "Logged on and was able to find someone near by quickly to have coffee with."; "Used it NYC, not that many users right now, but met up with someone to grab a drink and watch football in my neighborhood and now we watch games together every weekend."
- Privacy (per App Store labels): Data Used to Track You — Identifiers; Data Linked to You — Location, Contact Info (and advertising/other purposes as listed); Data Not Linked to You — Diagnostics/Crash Data.

## Founder & story (nbrlyapp.com/about.html)
- **Yaser Chow — Founder & CEO.** "Entrepreneur, product builder, and finance operator dedicated to strengthening real-world communities through technology." Mission: "To foster real-time, in-person connections… turn strangers into neighbors through quick, friendly meetups."
- Prior: **15+ years leading corporate finance and strategic planning across high-growth tech** — FP&A for **Alphabet** (Google, YouTube, Google Cloud, Other Bets: Waymo, Verily, Nest, Fiber, Sidewalk Labs, Isomorphic Labs), **The We Company's Ventures** portfolio, **Element Inc.** (biometrics identification startup); roles in Mexico City, London and Bangalore.
- **U.S. Marine Corps veteran** (diplomatic security for senior U.S. officials and embassies — Japan, South Africa, Saudi Arabia, Panama). BS in Finance, University of Florida.

## Positioning (objections from the site)
- **Not dating:** "NBRLY is friendship-first… not dating, not endless messaging, and not planning something three weeks from now." "No swiping."
- **Not another screen-time app:** "Most apps trap you on a screen. NBRLY is built to get you outside in the real world."
- **No algorithmic rage bait:** "No algorithms burying local voices or feeding rage bait."
- **Free and local:** "100% Free & Neighborhood Focused."

## Specifics for answers
- Download: onelink https://nbrly.onelink.me/5HNK/7ihl13q2 (QR on site) · site footer: "Download the App".
- Not stated on the materials: pricing tiers (it's free), Android version specifics, cities beyond NYC framing, user counts (no MAU/DAU published — only App Store ratings).
- Legal: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service at nbrlyapp.com/legal.html?tab=privacy / ?tab=terms (App Store links https://nbrlyapp.com/privacy-policy).

- hello@nbrlyapp.com · Instagram @nbrlyapp · TikTok @nbrlyapp
- Founder: linkedin.com/in/yaser-chow-a79a0b18/ · © NBRLY App (nbrlyapp.com)

# NYC Stoop — distilled knowledge (from the App Store listing as of 2026-10-19; developer site unreachable)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**NYC Stoop is a curated iOS guide to New York — "a few hundred places worth your time, chosen and described like a friend who lives there would, not a database of everything with a star rating."** It's an editorial field guide, not a reviews aggregator. Free to download and explore, with **no ads — ever**. Supports private photo sharing with friends.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Traveler: "Tell us when you're starting, your budget, and where — one tap builds a routed outing that actually fits the budget you picked."
- Local sharing with friends: "Share photos from the places you love (up to 5 per post, each with caption and place pin) — visible to friends only, never public."
- Planner: "Your saves turn into a routed day: grouped by neighborhood, with walking times and transit directions."

## Features (App Store description)
- **Explore:** browse by what you feel like doing — eat, drink, see art, hear live music, walk a neighborhood. Every place has an editorial description and an insider tip (what to order, when to go, which entrance to use).
- **Eat & Drink:** restaurants, cafés, bars across NYC, sorted by what's near you or by recommendations when planning from home.
- **Events:** live listings (concerts, shows, games) you can pin straight into your trip days.
- **Trips:** tap + on anything → saves turn into a routed day: grouped by neighborhood, with walking times and transit directions (which train/bus to take, where to board/off, how far to walk).
- **Plan It!:** "Tell us when you're starting, your budget, and where — one tap builds a routed outing that actually fits the budget you picked."
- **Your Stoop (new in 2.0):** share photos (up to 5 per post, each with its own caption and place pin) — every shared photo lands on your personal map. **Connect with private friend codes**: your photos are visible to friends only, never public. Comment on each other's finds, or add a friend's spot straight to your plan. The built-in **@NYC Stoop** account is your first friend, with curated spots across the city.
- Extras: neighborhood maps, weather-aware suggestions, comments and photo sharing that strip location metadata for privacy, "a design that feels like a beautiful field guide, not an app full of ads."

- **Free** · "no ads — ever"

- "Privacy practices may vary… For more information, see the developer’s privacy policy."

- Primary audience is NYC; creator is **HsiChun Wang**. Developer site unreachable — don't quote from it.
- The app's core is curation + private, friend-based sharing ("Your Stoop") + trip routing + budget-based planning.

# Nyedis — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Nyedis builds enterprise AI security and governance software centered on "Argent Strategic Intelligence" — a checkpoint that enforces identity, data protection, access limits, spend controls and auditability for AI agents and tools.** It also offers enterprise AI services (development, security/governance, integration, strategy/advisory) and the "AI Sentinel Protocol" (four maturity stages from Aware to Autonomous).

## Core product: Argent Strategic Intelligence
"See. Prove. Stop." Argent is positioned as a checkpoint between AI agents and everything they touch (MCP, RAG, A2A). **Six areas of control** (all enforced on every request): 
1. Know who acted (named human owner for every agent; owner-leave/off blocks agent; one screen of all agents with dollar tags)
2. Protect company data (DLP redaction: SSNs, card numbers, API keys, source code, secrets replaced with placeholders on outbound; scanned on inbound)
3. Limit access (agents can call only approved tools/MCP, document search returns only what the human can see; default deny; agent-to-agent governed)
4. Protect credentials (no real keys held by people/agents — signed into Argent, which injects real key from vault; never exposed)
5. Control the bill (dollar caps per company/org/dept/person/agent; hold money up front, settle after; emergency cap stops runaway loops; forecasts; can switch to cheaper models)
6. Check the evidence (every allow/deny/redact/quarantine is a signed, hash-chained, write-once record; offline verifier; can build a SOC 2 evidence bundle in under 30 seconds)

**How one request flows (high level):** 26 checks, 33 steps; < 100 ms policy decision; fails closed (if checker down, refuse); real key injected from vault only after checks; outbound/inbound scanned; token cost captured; denial returns immediately with no provider call. 

## Deployment & stack
Runs where you work: local in 2 minutes (one command), your cloud in ~20 minutes (Docker Compose, Helm for K8s — EKS/AKS/GKE/k3s/RKE2, AWS/Azure/GCP/on-prem), air-gapped on your own models (no internet/API keys at runtime). Open source core (gateway, filter chain, MCP proxy, A2A governance, offline verifier, signed audit chain) under Apache-2.0. Integrates with 23+ AI tools/SDKs (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Cline, OpenCode, LangChain/LangGraph, n8n, Ollama/LM Studio, Bedrock, etc.), many model providers, identity (Okta/Entra/Auth0/Keycloak/etc.), key vaults (Vault/OpenBao/CyberArk/1Password/etc.), policy engines (OPA built-in, Cerbos/SpiceDB/OpenFGA), guardrails, logs/alerts (Splunk/Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/OTel), object storage (S3/MinIO/Azure/GC).

## Enterprise AI Services
- **AI Agent Development** — custom agents, MCP integration, multi-cloud orchestration, RAG/fine-tuning, production deployment/scaling.
- **AI Security & Governance** — agent IAM, least-privilege, audit/SIEM, prompt-injection defense, compliance frameworks.
- **Enterprise Integration** — GCP/AWS/Azure, databases/data warehouses, SaaS (Salesforce/ServiceNow), legacy APIs, real-time pipelines.
- **AI Strategy & Advisory** — readiness, use-case prioritization/ROI, team structure/hiring, vendor selection, governance.
- **Identity & Cloud Engineering** — IGA, AM, PAM, identity orchestration, decentralized identity, PBAC, Web3; engagement models (Project, Staff Aug, Advisory, Managed Service, Support Blocks, Fixed-Bid/T&M/Milestone). 

## AI Sentinel Protocol
Four stages of AI security maturity: **Aware** (weekly threat intelligence), **Active** (real-time monitoring/alerts/playbooks), **Aligned** (central policy, compliance automation, audit trails, RBAC), **Autonomous** (self-defending AI, autonomous response, self-healing, predictive modeling, continuous evolution). Also "Why AI Sentinel?" — enterprise-grade security (20+ years IAM expertise), AI-native, full stack coverage, real-time response, evolving protection, compliance ready (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). 

## About / Team (from pages)
Built by enterprise identity/access security experts with **20+ years** in financial institutions, government, healthcare, higher education. Co-founders: **Ted Balfour** (CEO/Co-Founder), **Adam Callen** (CIO/Co-Founder). Extended team named (Kurt Bitner, Sifer Aseph, Sam Ng, Matt Cox, Charles Fee, April Valot). Media: "Nyedis Anarchy Series" on YouTube (@nyedisiam). 

## Key facts / positioning
- Tagline: **"See. Prove. Stop."** (Argent)
- "Enterprise AI That Delivers" (homepage)
- Open source core under Apache-2.0
- "Zero phone-home" (air-gapped capable); nothing phones home at runtime
- 26 checks / 33 steps per request; < 100 ms policy decision
- Build SOC 2 evidence bundle in under 30 seconds (offline-verifiable)
- 500+ enterprise deployments (site claim, 2026-10-19)
- "No model training" guarantee stated in Trust/Security framing (data never used to train/fine-tune models)

## Contacts
- Email: **ai@nyedis.com** (demo/contact)
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@nyedisiam
- Company: https://www.nyedis.com

# Omi — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Omi (by Based Hardware, San Francisco) is a wearable AI notetaker pendant ("your personal AI that remembers every conversation") plus desktop/phone/web software.** It captures what you say and do, turning it into summaries, tasks and searchable memory. Open source: software and hardware can run locally if you want. Tagline: "Your personal AI that remembers every conversation."

## Product
- **Omi pendant** — wearable AI notetaker that is always listening; captures conversations, then turns them into summaries, tasks and searchable memory. $129 (site price). "One memory. Two ways to wear it" — pendant on cord, a clip, or wrist band. Continuously captures (unlike a phone that stops when a call comes in, storage fills, or screen locks).
- **omi Glass** — open-source developer-focused smart glasses ("Omi Glass Dev Kit", $499 / list $799) that capture photos for lifelogging and AI-powered memory recall; hardware, firmware and software all open source (repo path `omi/OmiGlass` in github.com/BasedHardware/omi); 6× the battery life vs prior; fully hackable. Developer Kit & Brain Interface option.
- **Accessories** — wrist band ($59.99), charger ($29.99/$49.99), cords, etc. (collection page).
- **Apps** — desktop (Mac), mobile, web (app.omi.me) share the same memory ("The same memory on your Mac, your phone and the web").

## Manifesto / vision
"The next AI moat isn't intelligence. It's personal context." People choose the AI that *knows* them. Today's AI is "a vending machine: prompt → answer → forget." Omi is "your personal AI mentor" — it learns your life from what you say, do, and work on; it nudges, pushes, and keeps you honest. Belief: "Personal context beats raw IQ — a smaller model with your history beats a bigger model with none. The killer feature isn't chat. It's proactivity."
- **"How we win":** collect all data about the user; they'll trust it because Omi is open source; use the data for maximum personalization. "We use open source as a trust wedge."
- **Mission:** "Make humans 1,000× more productive."
- **Roadmap (four phases, one personal AI):**
  - Phase 1 · now — **Desktop software**: start where life happens (computer); capture meetings (what you said), files (who you are), screen (what you're doing). Milestone: **200k software users** (~$100k MRR, self-sustainable, organic growth).
  - Phase 2 — **Necklace (offline life)**: capture the world AI never sees: real life.
  - Phase 3 — **Glasses (real-time)**: "eyes beat ears for context by 10×"; AI sees what you see.
  - Phase 4 — **Brain (intent)**: intent before action; start with silent speech.

## Enterprise / Sales
- **Omi for Sales Teams** — record, summarize & close more deals; targets in-person sales. "Trusted by 14,000+ sales professionals."
- Features: always-on sales necklace; captures all in-person sales meetings; exports to Asana, HubSpot, Salesforce (saves reps 10+ hours/week per the site); manager/team coaching ("close 30% more deals"); advanced team controls (team dashboard, centralized user management, usage insights, device/member control); enterprise-grade security (encryption at rest and in transit; SOC 2 security controls and continuous monitoring).
- **Enterprise page** (omi.me/enterprise): bulk discounts — 10+ units 10% off, 100+ units 20% off, 1000+ units 30% off; 7–14 day delivery; "Trusted by 300,000+ professionals"; 7-day pilot with 5–10 free devices; $89/device refundable deposit; contact/book via cal.com/aaravgarg/enterprise; SOC2 + HIPAA claims; Vanta; integrations; industries.
- Ideal for real estate agents, car dealership sales reps, insurance advisors, medical device reps, coaches, and other high-value in-person conversation professionals.

## Case studies (examples)
- **Tony Robbins' Sales Team** uses Omi to capture and improve in-person sales conversations (thousands at large events; no clear way to track what was said before).
- (More case studies listed on /blogs/news/case-studies.)

## Audience / compliance / company
- Also markets to **Healthcare** (omi.me/healthcare) and **Technicians** (omi.me/technicians).
- Company: **Based Hardware Inc.**, San Francisco. © 2026 Based Hardware. Trust/compliance page at omi.me/trust.

## Contacts
- Email: **help@omi.me**
- X: @omidotme · LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/omidotme · GitHub: github.com/BasedHardware · TikTok/Instagram @omidotme · YouTube @omidotme · Discord: discord.omi.me
- School/enterprise: omi.me/enterprise; book via cal.com/aaravgarg/enterprise
- Free/open source: github.com/BasedHardware/omi

## Notes / caveats
- Site claims (300,000+ professionals, 14,000+ sales professionals, close 30% more deals, SOC 2 / HIPAA) are as stated by Omi; treat as vendor claims with date 2026-10-19.

# Perena — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing digital dollar whose value grows automatically as yield accrues (no staking or claiming).** It also offers risk-asset wrappers **SOL* and BTC*** and **tranching** (USD*-P Protected / USD*-J Junior). The goal is a full suite of on-chain "stablebanking" products.

## Products
- **USD STAR (USD*)** — fully collateralized, yield-bearing digital dollar; yield accrues into the price (compound), so balance becomes worth more over time; **no lock-ups**, redeem anytime in seconds on Solana. Backed by diversified portfolio: delta-neutral hedged positions, secured borrow-lend, stablecoins, and tokenized real-world assets (e.g. reinsurance fund by **OnRe**). Performance fee on yield (never on principal). Variable APY.
- **USD* Protected (USD*-P) / USD* Junior (USD*-J)** — tranching: protected seat sits behind a buffer of junior capital; junior absorbs losses first in exchange for higher upside. Lets users choose risk/return profile.
- **SOL*** — yield-bearing SOL wrapper (deposited SOL put to work across managed yield sources); yield accrues into exchange rate; SOL exposure (dollar value moves with SOL). Variable APY; performance fee on yield.
- **BTC*** — yield-bearing BTC wrapper (deposited cbBTC put to work); yield accrues into exchange rate; BTC exposure. Variable APY; performance fee on yield.
- **Perena Smart Borrow** (mentioned in docs) — borrowing-related product in the stack (docs structure exists).

## How it works (key mechanics)
- **Backing & reserves**: USD* is fully collateralized by a diversified portfolio of yield-generating positions; reserves attested publicly on the **Transparency Dashboard** (https://app.perena.org//transparency).
- **Yield accrues into price/exchange rate** (not distributed as claimable yield) — "nothing to claim or restake"; balance simply becomes worth more over time.
- **Liquid**: no lock-ups; redeem for supported stablecoin on Solana in seconds.
- **Deposits/withdrawals**: deposit USDC (or supported stablecoin) to receive USD* at current price; redeem back to supported stablecoin. For SOL*/BTC*: can deposit SOL/cbBTC (or supported stablecoin swapped in-txn) to mint; burning returns SOL/cbBTC; larger withdrawals may use redemption queue (usually minutes).
- **Risks**: "Perena structures risk, it does not remove it." USD* holders share proportional exposure; losses in underlying strategies would show up as lower USD* price. SOL*/BTC* carry price and strategy risks.
- **Fees**: performance fee on yield (deducted from returns, never from principal). No Perena deposit/withdrawal fees (standard Solana network fees may apply).

## Transparency & security
- **Transparency Dashboard** shows where capital is deployed across venues/strategies and reserve attestations (app.perena.org//transparency).
- **Diversification** across multiple venues/protocols to reduce reliance on single strategy/counterparty.
- **RWA repository** mentioned in docs (OnRe reinsurance fund cited as an example).

## Documentation / links
- Docs: https://perena.gitbook.io/perena (Welcome to Perena: "Your Stablebank")
- App: https://app.perena.org (Enter the app / dashboard/earn/convert)
- Discord: https://discord.gg/RRJDKJYneN
- Twitter/X: x.com/perena
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/perenafi
- USD* on Solscan: https://solscan.io/token/star9agSpjiFe3M49B3RniVU4CMBBEK3Qnaqn3RGiFM
- Support: help@perena.org

## Careers (per site)
"Welcome to Perena: Your Stablebank" — building liquid yield-bearing digital dollar and full suite of on-chain stablebanking products on Solana. Open roles listed on careers page.

## Notes
- The site emphasizes variable APY, performance fees on yield, and risk transparency (tranching, diversification, public dashboard).

# PitCrew — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**PitCrew is "The AI Crew Built for Financial Firms" — a governed AI platform of work with agents, policies (Ground Truth), documents/data (Collections), a Q&A assistant (Ask Kitt) and an evidence trail.** Delivers configured, running automation in ~5 working days (live in production on Day 5) via a PitCrew expert who maps workflows and calibrates to firm rules. 

## Core platform (from Platform page)
- **Agent Crew / agents:** 60+ ready-made agents, by the work they do (/agents). Build your own in **Factory** (/platform#factory).
- **Collections:** documents and data agents read/produce (agreements, policies, statements, meeting notes, client files) — upload or connect SharePoint/Google Drive/Box; client documents stay in client pools.
- **Ground Truth:** your firm's rules applied on every run — upload manuals/policies → named rules with owner/version; agents check against them. Three layers: firm policies, client signed docs, regulations. Formal verification (AWS Automated Reasoning) — rule either holds or doesn't.
- **Ask Kitt:** sits on every run/collection/firm; answers cite run, page, rule. Slash commands start agents (e.g. `/run <agent>`).
- **Integrations:** 40+ custodians/CRMs/portfolio systems + Garage (add firm's own API); 127 built-in capabilities. Runs in **Claude, Slack, email, API** — no new app to open.
- **Evidence/Artifacts (Laps/Evidence packs):** every run produces documented output (analysis, exception logs, decision rationale, citations) landing in evidence vault; can assemble exam packs (e.g. SEC Exam Pack) — auto audit trails, organized by regulation, pre-share checklist.
- **"Exam-ready evidence generated as a byproduct of every run"** — addresses multi-day SEC exam prep (cite evidence pack completeness, items).

## Engagement model ("How we work")
- **Four phases, five days:** Catalog (Day 1) → Configure (Day 2) → Calibrate (Days 3–4) → Operate (Day 5). Live in production Day 5.
- **Commitments:** FDE-led (PitCrew expert maps/owns/trains), Factory-delivered (built on platform, you don't touch builder), Outcome-tracked (QA sign-off, SLA reporting, ROI billing monthly tied to skills running, not seats).
- **Guardrails:** scope freezes at Pilot Memo; Day 7 hard ceiling (narrow scope, don't extend); no build without spec; if < 80% calibration agreement after reasonable effort → stop/re-scope; clock pauses when waiting on firm; 20 working days hard ceiling; zero data retention (processed in memory, leaves, nothing trained on); **SOC 2 Type II certified** (three-tier AWS network isolation, KMS encryption, TLS 1.2+).

## Trust & Security (from security page)
- **SOC 2 Type II** — independently audited (Security, Availability, Confidentiality); audit period Oct 2025–Mar 2026; audited by Assurion Services LLC; trust criteria TSP 100 2017 (revised 2022). Full report available on request.
- **Zero data retention** — customer data processed in memory during execution and not stored after completion; removed on request or per contract.
- **No model training** — client data/workflows/outputs never used to train/fine-tune any AI model (by PitCrew or third-party providers).
- **Stateless inference** — LLM calls stateless (no retention beyond request).
- **Infrastructure** — AWS (VPC private subnets, multi-AZ, AES-256 at rest via KMS, TLS 1.2+ in transit), continuous monitoring, DR documented/tested, least privilege + MFA, background checks, security training, SDLC security, vendor risk.

## Skills / use cases (examples)
Covers lifecycle: Marketing & referrals, Prospects & proposals, Client onboarding, Client meetings, Client service, Portfolio oversight, Billing & fees, Data & reporting, Compliance & risk. Billing & fees agents include fee schedule validation, quarterly reconciliation, cash availability analysis, fee calculation/invoices, fee settings vs agreement/ADV, signed agreement check.

## Free resource
**"Five Steps to Governed AI"** — 85-page free e-book (read online or download PDF) outlining a 5-step discipline (Decide / Ground / Calibrate / Prove / Operate). 95% of AI pilots never reach production; argues advantage is proving AI followed firm rules.

## Team (from About/Team)
Built by operators from LegalZoom, Intuit, Atlassian, Freshworks. Co-founder/leadership: Rishi Kulkarni (co-founder of Revvsales, acquired by LegalZoom; led LegalZoom India ops, AI CoE), Sameer Goel (solutions specialist, 30 years), Ramesh May (product exec; led Mint at Intuit, Commerce at Atlassian), Nixon James, CFP® (founder Shepherd Advisor LLC).

## Contacts
- Book diagnostic call / Get in touch via site (forms)
- "Tell us what's eating your team's time" form on homepage/platform
- Social/links: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/pitcrewinc/

**Radius is an IRL "meet-cute" dating app for singles in NYC.** It shows you who's single and physically in the same third space as you — café, bar, gym, park — in real time. # RunVault — distilled knowledge (from runvault.ai, crawled 2026-10-18; reviewed 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**RunVault is an AI agent infrastructure platform** providing a fully managed agent runtime. Each agent gets a real Linux sandbox with persistent `/workspace` storage. A server-side credential proxy keeps secrets out of the sandbox (injected only for the bound host), and every action is logged via audit trail. 

**One line per audience:**
- Engineering/DevOps: "Give an agent a real shell with secrets locked out, RBAC, audit logs and schedules."
- AI/agent builders: "Orchestrate agents with persistent workspace, skills, MCP servers, and on-demand sandboxes."
- Security/compliance: "Server-side secret injection (per-host), full audit trail, RBAC with per-resource grants."

## How it works (3 core parts)
1. **Sandbox** — Real Linux box; agent owns it. `/workspace` persists across restarts. No credentials land in sandbox env.
2. **Credential proxy** — Holds credentials server-side; injects only on calls to the hostname bound to each integration (prevents exfiltration via prompt injection).
3. **Audit row** — Every call logged with actor, tool, target, status (sandbox shells, integration calls, schedule fires, role changes).

## Key facts (from site)
- Model: **Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5** (built-in, no separate Anthropic bill). Free tier includes **2,500 model credits/month**.
- Free tier: 1 workspace, 1 seat; up to **5 schedules**, up to **5 skills**; sandbox + persistent `/workspace`, credential proxy + integrations, full audit log. No credit card.
- RBAC: Owner / Admin / Member / Viewer + per-resource grants (least privilege).
- Integrations/MCP: HTTP APIs via credential proxy; MCP server support (bring internal tooling).
- Schedules: cron/one-shot tasks; per-message debugging (tool calls, tokens, latency, system prompt) for owners/admins.
- Persistence: `/workspace` is persistent (volumes); anything outside treated ephemeral.
- Slack/Telegram/Discord: stated as coming (not available publicly yet).

## Audiences & use cases
- **Ops/on-call**: run real commands (shell/kubectl/curl) via proxy; every action audited.
- **Scheduled reports**: cron-owned by agent; secrets never touch sandbox.
- **Data wrangling**: drop files in `/workspace`, use jq/csvkit/pandas; files persist.
- **Integration glue**: connect HTTP API/MCP once; proxy injects secret only for bound host.

## Positioning
- **vs roll-your-own container+LLM**: main value is guardrails (secrets out of sandbox, per-host scoping, full audit trail, RBAC, schedules/skills/MCP included). Time to useful agent: under a minute vs days/weeks.

## Specifics
- Pricing: free to start (Team pricing "Coming soon"); contact form for team needs (SSO/SAML, custom roles, longer audit retention/export, priority support).
- Contact: website contact form (turnaround stated within 48 hours).
- Auth/app: sign in via Google; app at https://app.runvault.ai.
- Languages: English.

## Contacts/links
- Home: https://runvault.ai/
- App/login: https://app.runvault.ai
- Pricing: https://runvault.ai/pricing
- FAQ: https://runvault.ai/faq
- Contact: https://runvault.ai/#contact

# Runwork — distilled knowledge (from runwork.ai, crawled 2026-10-18; reviewed 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Runwork is a team cloud that sits underneath existing AI tools** (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, etc.). It gives teams shared "spaces" (per piece of work) containing files, AI instructions, chats, skills, apps/automations, data/integrations, permissions and audit. Teams keep using the tools they already prefer; Runwork preserves and shares what they learn/build.

**One line per audience:**
- Founder/Head of AI: "Make AI work compound — what anyone learns/builds with AI stays shared and reusable across tools."
- Team member: "Start chats in any AI tool with the same space context (files, skills, instructions)."
- Eng/ops/admin: "Deploy AI-built apps/automations in spaces with permissions, audit, and 3,600+ integrations/MCP."

## How it works (core ideas)
1. **Spaces** — One space per kind of work (e.g. onboarding, renewals). Holds files, AI instructions, chats, skills, apps/automations, data/integrations.
2. **Context follows you** — Start conversations from space in your preferred tool (Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/Copilot etc.). Runwork surfaces space context; chats stay on local machine unless shared.
3. **Share selectively** — Files/chats stay private until shared; changes tracked so team can pick what to share.
4. **Skills** — Save "how to do X" once (prompt/workflow) as a skill; everyone’s AI can use it.
5. **Apps & automations** — Describe what you need; AI builds app/automation in space; Runwork hosts it with auth/data/integrations.
6. **Integrations** — Connect accounts (HubSpot, Slack, Google Drive, Notion, Jira, GitHub, etc., 3,600+); credentials managed via Runwork; every call traceable.

## Key facts (from site)
- Surfaces: Desktop app, Web (login), works with many AI tools/agents (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot referenced).
- Connectors: MCP supported; 3,600+ integrations listed.
- Governance: Permissions, audit logs, auth/SSO mentioned in platform features; SOC 2 Type II "in progress".
- Sharing: Chats stay on computer unless explicitly shared; files private until shared.
- Knowledge reuse: Skills shared across space/team; AI instructions define behavior per space.
- Deployment: Apps/automations run in space context with sign-in/data/integrations.

## Use cases
- **Team onboarding to AI**: Give new people everything (files, instructions, skills) from day one.
- **Preserve best practices**: Turn proven prompts/workflows into reusable skills.
- **Automate workflows**: Build internal tools/automations from natural language; run in space.
- **Cross-tool collaboration**: Different people use different tools but share same space context.

## Specifics
- Pricing: 14-day free trial, no credit card (stated). See https://runwork.ai/pricing/ for details.
- About: https://runwork.ai/about/
- Login/app: https://runwork.ai/login
- Download: https://runwork.ai/download/
- Compare/resources/conversations also present.

# ShipSystems — distilled knowledge (from shipsystems.ai, crawled 2026-10-18; reviewed 2026-10-19)

## What it is (30 seconds)
ShipSystems is an AI engineering firm: they find where AI pays off in your enterprise, then build and ship scoped agents to production in your repo and cloud. Engagement-based approach (audit + build).

**One line per audience:**
- CTO/eng leadership: "Workflow audit to identify real AI opportunities, then ship scoped agents to production in your repo/cloud."
- Ops/product: "Find highest-value automations, build one scoped agent end-to-end, measure on real cases before going live."
- Enterprise teams: "Only pay for LLM where it earns its place; prefer deterministic (system one) where possible."

## Two-step engagement
- **Step 1 · Find** (2–3 weeks, fixed scope): audit operations/data/team; rank workflows by value/feasibility; produce prioritized roadmap with architecture + cost estimates. Credited toward first build if continue.
- **Step 2 · Build**: build one scoped agent end-to-end, measured on real cases before production. Phases: Prototype (working agent on your data, 2–3 wks), Evaluate (accuracy/cost/go/no-go, 1 wk), Production (shadow→supervised→autonomous, 2–4 wks), Operate (drift checks/tuning/runbook).

## How they think about LLMs
- Prefer **System one** (deterministic/rule-based selection) where possible: routing/classification/moderation/extraction checks/next-step choice; returns one of your options with probability; says "unsure" to escalate; fast/cheap (input tokens only).
- Use **System two** (LLM/chat) only where needed: drafting/summarizing/multi-step reasoning/explanation; free text output; slower/more costly (input+output).
- Mark each decision as system one or system two during Step 1.

## Proof/notes
- Clients include Dreamit Ventures, Glass Entertainment Group, MOD, Scribble, Perry AI, EFS Networks, Panga AI, Syrch, Orchid Studio (logos listed).
- Philosophy: if honest answer is "don't build it", they say so.
- Contact/demo: https://calendly.com/n-makatche/30min

## Limits
- Full pricing not published (engagement-based). Roadmap includes architecture/cost estimates in Step 1 (fixed scope). Credit toward build if proceed.

# Synced — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-18)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Synced is an AI inbox that finds and completes work across your messages.** It reads email and messages, finds files, checks calendars, drafts responses, turns messages into tasks, and coordinates schedules — but nothing sends without your approval. It's in private beta (web + iOS).

**One line for different audiences:**
- Founder: "Your inbox on autopilot — drafts replies, books meetings, pulls files; you approve before sending."
- EA/sales/recruiter: "Handles busywork across email/messages, calendar, and files with human-in-the-loop approval."
- Knowledge worker: "Turns messages into actionable work (tasks) and coordinates next steps without app-switching."

## How it works (high level)
- **Read & understand** — Parses email/messages to identify work
- **Gather context** — Searches email, files, cloud storage, calendar
- **Draft & propose** — Writes replies, creates documents, proposes meetings, creates tasks
- **Human-in-the-loop** — "Nothing sends without you" — all AI-drafted messages wait for approval
- **Execute on approval** — Handles follow-ups and tracks progress

## Key details
- Tagline: "Your AI Inbox on Autopilot"
- Claim: "Replies drafted. Meetings booked. Synced reads your email and messages, finds the files, checks your calendar, and writes the response. You approve before anything sends."
- Integrations: Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Business, Instagram Business, Messenger, SMS, GroupMe, Google Drive, OneDrive, Google Calendar (+ more)
- Platforms: Web + iOS (private beta)
- Access: Get Early Access (forms.gle links)
- Pricing: Free (20 Action Plans/week, unlimited inboxes, 4 accounts each, core integrations, Decide queue & Tasks). - "Action Plan" defined/glossary linked
- Privacy/security: "Your data isn't training data. Google Workspace data is never used to train AI models." Security page linked.
- Team: Aum Dhruv and Nick Harty

Founders, Executive assistants, Sales, Recruiters, Consultants, Agencies, Real estate agents, Small business owners

- Human-in-the-loop by design (approval required)
- Focuses on "work" in inbox (tasks, scheduling, drafting)

# Taxnova — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-18)

## What it is (30 seconds)
Taxnova is an AI-powered R&D tax claims automation platform for tech companies. It finds qualifying capital expenditure (capex) and R&D tax credits directly from company engineering and financial data, rather than reconstructing them from timesheets and interviews. The platform connects to existing tools (GitHub, Jira, Linear, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Notion, Google Docs, Slack, Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite) and produces audit-ready claim documentation.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Finance/Tax/CFO: "Automates R&D tax claim preparation with audit-ready evidence, reducing effort ~80% and improving defensibility."
- Engineering/CTO: "Zero engineer disruption on interviews or timesheets — pulls evidence from tools engineers already use."
- R&D advisors: "Complements advisors (doesn't replace them) by automating data collection and producing traceable documentation."

## How it works (3 steps)
1. **Connect** — read-only access to engineering/finance systems (setup ~30-60 min). Never writes back, no source code access, metadata only.
2. **Identify & size** — AI identifies qualifying R&D projects, contributors, time allocations across teams/countries from actual activity (tickets, commits, documents). 
3. **Claim ready** — generates technical narratives linked to source evidence (audit-ready), for review and submission with your advisor.

## Key facts
- **Coverage**: Live in US, UK, Canada, France, Spain. Planning 10 more countries by end of 2027.
- **Security/compliance**: SOC 2 Type 2 (Trust Center: trust.taxnova.ai), encrypted in transit/at rest, annual 3rd-party pen tests, no training/fine-tuning of LLMs on client data, isolated storage per customer, UK GDPR/GDPR, DPA available, read-only/scoped tokens revocable anytime, Slack limited to explicitly connected public channels.
- **AI**: Uses third-party LLM APIs (Anthropic, Google Gemini/Vertex AI); providers contractually prohibited from training/fine-tuning on client data. Processing is processor-side for client work.
- **Pricing**: Not stated on public site (price on request / via demo).
- **Integrations**: Engineering — Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps. Docs — Confluence, Notion, Google Docs. Comm — Slack. Finance/Payroll — Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite.
- **Differentiator**: Evidence-grounded (every claim item traced to source tickets/commits/docs), continuous capture (avoids year-end scramble), covers multi-country rules, works alongside advisors.
- **Backed by**: a16z Speedrun, s16vc, Karaoke Club and operators.

## Three audiences
### Finance leaders (CFO, FD, Controller)
- Audit-ready, traceable documentation with rationale for each decision.
- Earlier visibility into accumulated R&D amounts throughout the year (not just YE).
- Systematic coverage across teams/geographies, reduces underclaiming risk.
- Fits alongside existing advisor/internal tax team.

### Engineering leaders (CTO, VP/Head of Eng)
- Pulls evidence from tools already used; few targeted follow-ups (no broad surveys/interviews).
- Narratives grounded in tickets/commits/docs, reducing revision cycles.
- ~80% reduction in prep effort reported (per case studies).
- Preserves engineering focus on shipping.

### Advisors / multi-country orgs
- One platform covering multiple jurisdictions (US, UK, CA, FR, ES) with rule alignment; expands to 10 more by end-2027.
- Produces structured outputs designed for audit defense; advisors retain final review/sign-off.
- Transparent with assumptions/confidence and explicit decision rationale.

## Positioning / objections
- **Not replacing advisors**: Complements existing R&D tax advisors (handles heavy lifting, improves quality/evidence). Explicitly stated.
- **Reduces audit risk**: Evidence-first, traceability, consistent narratives, explicit assumptions/gaps.
- **Beyond generic LLMs**: A purpose-built pipeline beats general-purpose agents on completeness (missed projects/people/contributions), evidence depth, and ability to signal gaps (per published Claude vs Taxnova benchmark). General models struggle to cover multi-project people and large corpora without purpose-built ingestion/workflow.

## Case studies (highlights)
- **incident.io (UK, 40+ engineers)**: ~80% reduction in prep effort, lighter process, clearer defensible documentation, less senior engineer time.
- **causaLens (UK)**: Time allocation work reduced from weeks to a couple of hours; surfaced projects missed manually; systematic, evidence-backed.
- **Augment (US, ~100 engineers)**: Helped identify ~$500K R&D credit they lacked visibility into with more defensible, transparent, data-grounded approach; better economics.

## Specifics for answers
- **Source of truth**: taxnova.ai (RU/UK site; content in English). 
- **Data handling**: Read-only, metadata only, no source code, never trains/fine-tunes models on client data, isolated per customer, revocable tokens.
- **Scope**: Focuses on data preparation (project identification, time allocation, evidence/narratives). Costing/tax computation/filing typically done with advisor (out of scope of the automation layer).
- **Benchmark note**: Taxnova published a comparison vs Claude Fable (2026) showing purpose-built pipeline avoids missed projects/contributors and better represents multi-project work.

## Contacts
- Website: https://taxnova.ai/
- Trust Center (SOC 2): https://trust.taxnova.ai/
- Legal: Privacy/Terms at https://taxnova.ai/legal/privacy and https://taxnova.ai/legal/terms
- Demo: https://calendly.com/d/ctjs-87b-hch
- Founder: George Nichkov (CEO/CFO), Maria Malykh (CTO)
- LinkedIn per CSV: Emily Cummin (poster) — per founder's intro in the Connectors WhatsApp group — not stated on the site.

(End of file)

## What it is (30 seconds)
Treetracker is a climate/wildfire prevention startup building low-cost ground sensors that turn the earliest environmental signals into localized wildfire alerts. It aims to fill the gap where satellites/aircraft can be delayed or not localized enough — delivering earlier ground-level warnings to communities/land managers.

- Land managers/utilities: "Low-cost ground sensors + localized alerts to detect wildfire risk earlier at the hotspot level."

# Venture Week — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-18)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Venture Week** is a decentralized, distributed startup tech conference organized as city-specific weeks. Per the site: "Venture Week is a decentralized, distributed tech conference. It means every event on the Venture Week calendar is independently hosted & produced. A marketplace of events, in your city, for one week per year." It publishes city calendars (aggregating submitted startup events) and hosts Venture Week mixers in each city.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Startup organizers: "Submit your event to the Venture Week calendar for your city's week and reach the local startup community."
- Founders/attendees: "A week of independently hosted startup events in your city — one calendar for everything happening during Venture Week."
- Partners/sponsors/media/city partners: "Partner with Venture Week to support events across a city's startup ecosystem during its designated week."

## How it works
1. **City weeks** — Each city has a designated Venture Week (e.g., San Francisco Aug 16-22 2026, Seattle Aug 23-29 2026, Chicago Sep 6-12 2026, New York Sep 13-19 2026, Austin Sep 20-26 2026, Boston Oct 25-31 2026, San Diego Nov 8-14 2026).
2. **Decentralized events** — Every event listed is independently hosted and produced (not centrally produced by Venture Week).
3. **Marketplace of events** — The calendar aggregates submitted startup events for that city during its week.
4. **Submit events** — Organizers submit events via the Submit Event form; submissions are reviewed/processed per the submission flow described on the site.
5. **Partners** — City partners, media partners, and sponsors can get involved to support the week.

## Key cities and dates (from crawled pages, 2026)
- San Francisco: August 16–22, 2026
- Seattle: August 23–29, 2026
- Chicago: September 6–12, 2026
- New York: September 13–19, 2026
- Austin: September 20–26, 2026
- Boston: October 25–31, 2026
- San Diego: November 8–14, 2026

## Audiences
- Event organizers (startups, communities, accelerators, VCs, coworking spaces) who want to list events during Venture Week
- Founders, builders, investors, students and startup community members attending events
- City/community partners, media partners, sponsors looking to support a city's startup week

## Specifics for answers
- **Decentralized model**: Venture Week does not produce every event — it aggregates independently hosted startup events into one city calendar for that week.
- **Submission process**: Events can be submitted via the Submit Event page; the form collects event details to be included in that city's calendar.
- **Partnerships**: Partner With Us, Sponsorship, City Partners, Media Partners pages exist (content available in crawled pages). Specific partnership terms/details are as stated on those pages.

# Veoforge — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-18)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Veoforge** is an AI video platform that creates video ads from a product page or brief in minutes. It positions as "AI Video Ads From Your Product Page, in Minutes" — automated agent platform for going from idea to video with major models (including Seedance 2.5). It offers a free first video for qualifying companies (no credit card) and also does creative production/automation beyond video.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Performance marketers/brands: "Turn your product page into fresh video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube in ~12 minutes; iterate versions to fight creative fatigue."
- Agencies/in-house creative: "Brief it, approve script/storyboard first (no credits spent until approved), get finished brand videos back."
- Operations teams: "Beyond video, we automate repetitive ad/ops work (reports, data extraction, calls/questions) with AI."

## How it works
1. **Share** — Paste product page link or write brief; pulls product details, photos, brand colors.
2. **Approve plan** — Review script and storyboard scene by scene; no credits spent until you approve.
3. **Get ad** — Creates scenes, adds voiceover/captions, assembles; first version ~12 minutes.
4. **Run & iterate** — Use on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, product pages; make new versions when performance drops.

## Key features/claims
- First cut ~12 minutes; refine with version history and lip-synced voiceovers.
- Supports major models including Seedance 2.5 (stated in tagline/category).
- Free first video for qualifying companies, no credit card.
- You approve before anything is made (no spend until storyboard/script approved).
- Every ad is yours; can use uploaded presenters or product-only (no presenter).
- Use cases: performance video ads, digital twin videos (white-glove custom pricing), social media videos, SaaS/AI explainers, creative production partner.
- Also offers "beyond video" automation (ad reports, PDFs/invoices/bookings → spreadsheets, answering calls/questions) for select businesses.

## Positioning (common objections/solutions stated)
- Creative fatigue: make fresh versions when ads tire (creative fatigue checker tool linked).
- Cost/time of shoots: filmed ads $3k–$8k and take days/weeks; Veoforge ~12 minutes from product page.
- Need many versions for testing (hooks, lengths, sizes) without starting from scratch.
- No footage/product pages only: generate from product photos/page.
- No time to edit: handles script, VO, captions, assembly.

- Creative fatigue checker (/tools/cf-check), creative diversity checker (/tools/creative-diversity)
- Beyond video (/beyond-video), How it works (/how-it-works), Pricing (/pricing), Production showcase (/production-showcase)
- Docs (/docs/welcome), Blog (https://blog.veoforge.com)
- Competitor comparison pages under /docs/vs/ (HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, Luma, Creatify, InVideo, Fliki, CapCut, Kling, Oxolo, Higgsfield, Adobe Firefly)
- "Ask AI about us" links to ChatGPT/Claude with veoforge.md reference; download guide (/veoforge.md)
- Social: TikTok @veoforge, Instagram @veoforge, YouTube @veoforge, X @veoforge

## Pricing/terms
- Free first video for qualifying companies; no credit card (stated). Pricing page exists (/pricing). Digital twin videos are white-glove custom pricing.
- "No credits spent on video until you're happy with the plan" (approval gate).

- Beyond video work already done for agency/travel/hotel (case references).

**Worldcastr** is described as a "foundation lab for physical development" building "the benchmark, training data, and model that predict how places change." # Yerk — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-18)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**Yerk is a macOS app for music producers** that "organizes samples, backs up every session, and moves projects between DAWs, so you can spend your time making music." It runs locally on your Mac — the sample classifier ships inside the app, uploads nothing, and never moves your original files. First build ships **November 2026** (macOS first; Windows later); preorder is **$15 one-time**, refundable until delivery.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Producers: "Stop managing files: find any sound by BPM/key/mood, keep every session hash-verified and versioned, and open an FL Studio project in Ableton."
- Collaborators/mixers: "Send a Logic session to an Ableton user — they open a session, not a folder of loose files (FL Studio→Ableton live today)."
- Privacy-minded producers: "100% local: no server receives your audio; works offline and on unreleased material."

## How it works (4 product pillars)
1. **Smart Sample Search / auto-tagging** — Point Yerk at folders/drives. It reads the file name first (only if unambiguous), then analyzes the audio (tempo, key, genre, instrument, mood) entirely on your Mac, and files an *organized library* whose folder names carry the tags — searchable in Finder, Logic/Live browsers, or any DAW. Originals stay where they were; unreadable files are listed with counts (never silently skipped).
2. **Project Conversion (DAW transfer)** — FL Studio `.flp` → Ableton Live 12 `.als`, read/written locally, instruments, patterns, tempo, sample references and mapped effects survive; approximation marks where no exact equivalent exists; third-party plugins must be installed on the opening Mac. Built from analysis of **558 real FL Studio projects**. Logic Pro, Pro Tools, Cubase "next."
3. **Version Backups** — Hash-verified versions of DAW projects (Logic `.logicx` bundles copied as bundles, Ableton, FL Studio, Pro Tools) to Dropbox, Google Drive or an external drive, on a schedule, whether or not Yerk is open.
4. **Collaborate seamlessly** — *Coming soon*: shared project work, audio/MIDI/automation intact, notes on the clip and bar (waitlist).

## Key figures (site, as of crawl 2026-10-18)
- Preorder: **$15**, one-time, no recurring charges; refundable any time before shipping; ships **November 2026** (macOS first, preorder covers Windows later).
- **558** real FL Studio projects analyzed to build/validate the converter.
- **558 projects analysed / SHA-256 every version verified / 100M+ streams in our network** (homepage counters).
- Waitlist: **34 producers already on the list**, 100M+ combined streams across the producer network.
- Not a plugin; standalone Mac app. macOS only at first release.

## About the company (from /about)
- Two co-founders in **Berkeley, California**: **Kamo Aghbalyan** (Co-founder & CEO — 4+ years engineering at Krisp (SkyDeck) and Activeloop (YC); Master's in Entrepreneurship, Babson; classically trained pianist/vocalist) and **Alec Leddon** (Co-founder & COO — 10+ years artist/producer/DJ, 20M+ streams, 30K+ followers, toured NA & Europe; Babson Master's; founder of TaeSun, NIH-funded startup that raised $500K+).
- Why: "Making music got smarter. Managing it did not." Built one app instead of four. Principles: runs on your machine (unreleased music doesn't belong on someone else's server), never moves originals, says what it skipped.

## Positioning (from /alternatives)
- One app instead of 3–4 subscriptions: sample organizer + converter + backup (vs Sononym, XO, Atlas, Waves Cosmos, Splice, Jukeblocks, Backblaze/Time Machine).
- vs Splice: Splice = new sounds to download; Yerk = the sounds you already own (both fine together).
- vs sample organizers: they organize inside their own browser/plugin; Yerk organizes the files so tags are folder names visible everywhere.
- vs Jukeblocks: same job, but on your Mac, nothing uploaded, alongside backups.
- vs Backblaze/Time Machine: general file copy ≠ versioned, verified, still-openable DAW project backup.

## FAQ highlights (from /faq)
- Audio never uploaded; classifier runs locally; backups go to your chosen destination.
- No file renaming/moving: organized library is separate; originals untouched.
- Backups cover Logic Pro, Ableton Live, FL Studio, Pro Tools (incl. `.logicx` bundles).
- Hash-verified = checksum of every copied file vs source; only counts when copies match; recent versions kept.
- Not a plugin; results show in Finder/DAW browsers.
- Post-launch price: **not set yet** — preorders are told launch pricing first.

## Contact / links
- Contact: info@yerk.io · Book a call: /chat · Preorder: /preorder (Stripe) · FAQ: /faq · About: /about · Alternatives: /alternatives
- Blog: /blog (e.g., "Keep the Music Human. Let Yerk Handle the Rest.", 2026-09-25, Alec Leddon)
- Social: Instagram @yerk_music, X @yerk_music, LinkedIn /company/yerk/, Facebook page
- Founder contacts (metadata): Alec Leddon (alec-leddon on LinkedIn, WA 140746246107360@lid); Kamo Aghbalyan (kamo-aghbalyan, WA 208572235411496@lid)

# YESODI — distilled knowledge (from the website as of 2026-10-18)

## What it is (30 seconds)
**YESODI** is a social commerce platform that positions itself as "where your business sells itself." The site states: "Build your professional identity on Yesodi. Bring together who you are, your companies, brands, products, services, articles, videos, music and professional work in one connected profile that is found on Google and AI search." Its tagline is **"Publish. Sell. Connect."** The platform aims to help monetize every post, product, search, and link via a unified professional identity.

**One line for different audiences:**
- Creators/founders: "One connected professional identity that brings together your work, brands, and products — publish, sell, connect."
- Businesses: "Monetize every post, product, search and link; your business sells itself through one discoverable profile."
- Community organizers: "A hub with events, channels, marketplace, and directories (people/brands/business) with content feeds (posts, intel, videos, music, news)."

## How it works / features (from homepage)
1. **Professional identity/profile** — Single connected profile combining companies, brands, products, services, articles, videos, music, professional work.
2. **Monetization** — "Monetize every post, product, search and link."
3. **Discoverability** — Profiles and content are "found on Google and AI search."
4. **Content feeds** — Latest Posts, Intel Articles, Community Videos, Community Music, Community News; posts with titles, snippets, links to individual items.
5. **Directories & marketplace** — People Directory (/people), Brands Directory (/brands), Business Directory (/directory), Marketplace (/explore), Events (/events).
6. **Channels** — Thematic channels (e.g., Personal Development, Travel, Aviation, Tennis, Movies, Real Estate, Business & Deals, plus community channels).

- Explore channels (many named channels)
- Latest Posts / Intel / Videos / Music / News feeds
- Community Events (long list on homepage)
- New Listings (Marketplace listings appear on homepage)

## Positioning
- Social commerce platform ("Publish. Sell. Connect.")
- Focus on professional identity + discoverability (SEO/AI search)
- Aggregates content, people, brands, events, marketplace in one place.

- The homepage is content-rich (posts, events, listings, directories) — the site appears to be a content/community platform with social commerce framing.
